subject: Preferred invoice lane, PO id reconciliation, and one-time net45 request
messages:
From: Susan Keller <susan.keller@careco.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com
Cc: accounts-payable@careco.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Preferred invoice lane & PO id reconciliation

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — CareCo is keen to move to a pilot but procurement needs to verify invoicing and PO handling before legal signs off. A few specific asks from our side:

- We operate on a blanket/master PO model. Can Redwood accept a single blanket PO (one master PO number) and then have multiple invoice-level child PO IDs referenced on each invoice? Our ERP needs a PO_ID field on each invoice line to reconcile payments.
- What invoice cadence options do you support? We prefer a single monthly consolidated invoice (one invoice for the month that references multiple PO IDs/lines) rather than many small invoices.
- Standard net terms at CareCo are net45 for vendors under $250k annual, but we can be flexible. Can Redwood accept net45 for the pilot quarter?
- Please provide your required PO metadata fields (fields we must include on the PO), remittance/payment instructions, and any vendor codes we should use.

I attached our PO template for reference (CareCo_PO_template.pdf). If you can confirm the above and outline any exceptions/workarounds, procurement will fast-track the MSA redline.

Best,
Susan Keller
Head of Procurement, CareCo Health
(susan.keller@careco.com)


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Susan Keller <susan.keller@careco.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Preferred invoice lane & PO id reconciliation

Hi Susan — thanks, and appreciate the clear list. High-level answers and next steps below.

Summary (short):
- We can support a blanket/master PO with invoice-level child PO IDs. Must include PO_ID in the invoice header and as a discrete metadata field for ERP ingestion.
- Monthly consolidated invoice is supported; we can include a line-level reference column that maps back to your child PO IDs.
- Standard Redwood payment terms are net30. We can escalate a one-time net45 for the pilot quarter pending finance sign-off and a signed addendum to the MSA.

Details / Requirements:
1) PO metadata we need on the PO (and populated on each invoice):
   - PO_ID (your child PO number) — required, max 30 chars
   - MASTER_PO (the blanket PO number) — required
   - COST_CENTER or BU_CODE — optional but required for some customers; include if present
   - BILLING_CONTACT_EMAIL — helpful for AP routing

2) Invoice format for monthly consolidated invoice: 
   - One PDF invoice per month containing: invoice header (invoice number, date, total), followed by CSV attachment (or embedded table) with individual line items that include child PO, service period, quantity, unit price, and line amount.
   - Alternatively we can provide one PDF plus a machine-readable CSV for your ERP.

3) Remittance / vendor setup:
   - Vendor name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Remittance address and ACH instructions: see attached (Redwood_remittance_details.pdf).
   - Vendor code: we do not require a specific code but will accept a vendor_code field on the PO if you have one.

4) Net terms / exceptions: 
   - Standard: net30.
   - One-time pilot request: finance has approved considering net45 for Q4 pilot if: (a) we receive the signed blanket PO, (b) a one-page billing addendum is signed (DocuSign), and (c) we have an initial month of spend below our credit threshold or a short credit check.

Next steps I propose:
- I will loop in Finance (cc'd: PrIyom) to confirm mapping and the addendum language.
- If that looks OK, please send the signed blanket PO (CareCo_PO_template.pdf completed) and I will open the addendum DocuSign from our side.
- We will produce a sample consolidated invoice (PDF + CSV) for your ERP team to validate before the pilot billing run.

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf; Redwood_remittance_details.pdf

Happy to hop on a 20-min call with AP if that helps clarify the CSV mapping.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com

From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Susan Keller <susan.keller@careco.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Preferred invoice lane & PO id reconciliation (Finance notes)

Hi Susan / Vanessa — quick finance notes to make sure ERP ingestion will be smooth.

Confirmed: we can accept a single monthly consolidated invoice that references multiple child PO_IDs. For automated ingestion into our billing system we need a machine-readable CSV with the following columns (we'll include a sample):
- invoice_number, invoice_date, master_po, child_po_id, service_start, service_end, sku, qty, unit_price, line_amount, cost_center

Please use the child_po_id (your term) in the child_po_id column. If CareCo can populate that CSV at delivery, we can reduce manual reconciliation time considerably. I've attached invoice_mapping_sample.csv for your ERP team.

Net45 request: finance can approve a one-time net45 for Q4 pilot under these conditions:
1) Signed blanket PO on company letterhead from CareCo (we will need copy uploaded to our vendor portal).
2) Signed billing addendum (DocuSign) that temporarily amends payment terms for the pilot quarter.
3) No outstanding credit issues at time of first invoice.

If you want, Vanessa and I can draft a single-sentence addendum that only amends payment terms and references the master PO — keeps legal work minimal.

Regards,
PrIyom Das
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations
priyom.das@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: invoice_mapping_sample.csv
